function.name: get_code_neighbors
function.description:
Discover structural code graph neighbors (callers and callees) for a given code node.

Args:
    node: Dotted symbol path or suffix of the function, method, or class node (e.g. 'pkg.module.Class.method', 'Class.method', or 'parse_request').
    edge_type: Optional edge relation filter (e.g. 'calls', case-insensitive).
    max_neighbors: Maximum number of neighbor nodes to return (default: 50).

Returns:
    Dictionary with list of neighbor node names and count.

function.name: get_code_subgraph
function.description:
Extract the relationship graph (nodes and connecting edges) for a focal set of code elements.

Args:
    nodes: List of dotted symbol paths or suffix names (e.g. ['pkg.mod.Class.method', 'helper_fn']) to include in the induced subgraph.

Returns:
    Dictionary detailing the subgraph nodes and connecting directed edges.

function.description: Submit final graph answer; connected requires at least two nonempty node IDs, unavailable requires an empty path.

function.name: graph_find_paths
function.description:
Find one bounded stored undirected graph-only adjacency witness per pair.

Exact IDs or unambiguous suffixes resolve endpoints. Whole-query bounds
are 160 visited nodes and 800 original edge rows. Cells are connected,
no_path_within_bound, or unknown; identity is unknown. Bounded absence
requires resolved distinct endpoints and a completed anchor search; it
says nothing about source/runtime behavior. source_grounding=not_performed.

Args:
    source_nodes: One to three exact graph node IDs or unambiguous suffixes.
    target_nodes: One to eight exact graph node IDs or unambiguous suffixes.
    max_hops: Positive hop bound from one through four, excluding bool.

Returns:
    Complete original-row paths, per-pair states, frontier and accounting.
    Status is complete, partial, unavailable, or error. No bug ranking.
